runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Bulgogi-Style Beef Lettuce Wraps, Moroccan Chicken Tagine, Roasted Pears with Gorgonzola
runs.content:
1. Bulgogi-Style Beef Lettuce Wraps — inspired by David Chang. A 30-minute weeknight ssäm-format wrap — the same soy-ginger-garlic pantry as the Momofuku pork centrepiece, in a fraction of the time.
2. Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon and Olives — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A medium-technique weekend braise drawing on his North African travels — cinnamon, saffron, and ras el hanout for the first proper cool weekend of autumn.
3. Roasted Pears with Gorgonzola, Walnuts and Honey — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the first good pears of the season, warm fruit against sharp blue cheese, barely a recipe at all.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata, Khinkali, Honey-Roasted Quince
runs.content:
1. Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Green Beans — inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 30-minute weeknight fix built around mastering one useful pan-sauce technique (deglaze, reduce, mount with butter).
2. Khinkali (Georgian Soup Dumplings) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A medium-technique weekend project — Georgia's broth-filled dumplings, discovered on Parts Unknown, in the same spirit as the Filipino adobo and Sichuan dan dan already in the collection.
3. Honey-Roasted Quince with Cardamom, Bay and Cream — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the first proper quince of early autumn, given nothing but time in a slow oven.
